_comment: Simulation-only config: a single focused compare-optimizers run -- the former run_simulation.sh responsibility. Invoke via run_end_to_end.sh with CONFIG_JSON pointing here and --steps simulate, e.g.: CONFIG_JSON=simulation_experiments/configs/simulation_only_config.json MODE=prod ./scripts/run_end_to_end.sh --steps simulate. Unlike experiment_config.json (which sweeps multiple task counts and unions main+ablation schedulers to produce the full figure set), this config fixes one task count and the main scheduler list only, making it a direct, config-driven replacement for run_simulation.sh. To change the task count or scheduler subset, edit the values below -- there are no CLI overrides (by design: experiment parameters live in JSON, not in shell env).
_comment_on_naming: All keys use full descriptive names, mirroring experiment_config.json. Times are in seconds unless noted.

test_mode._comment: Quick smoke validation of the single-N compare run (run_simulation.sh defaults at smoke scale).

prod_mode._comment: Paper-grade single-N compare run -- the direct equivalent of the former run_simulation.sh defaults (N=6, 10 tasksets, 300s, main schedulers, seed 1000). parallel_worker_processes=null leaves worker count at compare_optimizers' auto default (min(4, cpu_count)); set an integer to pin it.

plotting._comment: Publication-quality figure styling parameters (same defaults as experiment_config.json).

analysis._comment: Parameters controlling metric computation and data filtering (same defaults as experiment_config.json). enable_resume_from_existing_results=false mirrors run_simulation.sh's default (RESUME unset); set true to skip already-completed intervals.
